Lily quickly grabbed a piece of paper and drew a line around their picnic blanket. "This line will stop the ants," she said. And it worked! The ants didn't cross the line and the girls enjoyed their picnic without any unwanted guests.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. Timmy loved to play outside with his friends, but one day he fell and hurt his knee. He cried and cried because it hurt so much. His mom gave him a bandage to help his knee feel better.

The next day, Timmy wanted to play outside again, but there was a big wall in his way. It was too difficult for him to climb over, so he had to go around it. He felt sad because it took him a long time to get to his friend's house.

Timmy's friend asked him why he was late, and Timmy told him about the wall. His friend said, "I suffer from the same problem. Let's ask our moms to help us find a way to make it easier to get around the wall." Timmy felt happy that he wasn't the only one with a difficult problem.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved playing with her toys and spending time with her family. One day, Lily's mommy had an emergency and had to go to the hospital. Lily missed her mommy so much and felt sad.

While her mommy was away, Lily learned how to be brave and help her daddy. She helped him cook dinner and clean the house. She even did her best to make her daddy smile. 

When her mommy came back home, Lily was so happy and hugged her tightly. Her mommy told her how proud she was of her for being so helpful and brave. Lily felt proud too! She learned that even when things are rare and unexpected, she can be strong and help others.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to watch cartoons on her TV screen. One day, Lily's mom showed her a brilliant new cartoon. Lily was so happy and watched it for hours. 

The next day, Lily's friends came over to play. Lily wanted to show them the new cartoon she found, but when she turned on the TV, something embarrassing happened. The screen didn't work! 

Lily felt embarrassed that she couldn't show her friends the brilliant new cartoon. But her friends didn't mind, they played together and had fun anyway. The next day, Lily's dad fixed the screen and she was able to show her friends the cartoon. They all laughed and had a good time. The end.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. Lily loved to play outside in her backyard. One day, she saw a pretty butterfly flying around. The butterfly had pretty colors on its wings. Lily wanted to catch the butterfly, but it was too fast.

Lily's mom came outside and said, "Lily, it's time to come inside for lunch." Lily didn't want to leave the butterfly, but she knew she had to quit trying to catch it. 

After lunch, Lily went back outside to play. She saw the butterfly again, but this time it was on a flower. Lily didn't want to scare the butterfly, so she watched it quietly. The butterfly flew away and Lily felt happy. She didn't want to spoil the butterfly's fun.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She lived in a small house with her mom and dad. One day, Lily's mom made a meal for them to eat. But the meal was not very good. It was a poor meal.

Lily's dad said, "This meal is not very good. Can you tell me what you put in it?"

Lily's mom said, "I put in some vegetables and some meat, but I think I forgot to put in some spices."

Lily said, "Mom, I can help you next time. I will tell you what spices to put in."

From that day on, Lily helped her mom make meals and they were never poor again.

Once upon a time, there was a big jungle. In the jungle, there were many wild animals like lions, tigers, and monkeys. They all spoke different languages, but they could understand each other.

One day, a monkey wanted to count how many bananas he had. He asked the lion, "Can you help me number my bananas?" The lion said, "Sure, I can count for you." So, the lion counted the bananas for the monkey.

After that, the monkey and the lion became good friends. They learned each other's language and played together in the jungle. The end.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. Timmy loved playing with his toy guns and pretending to be a cowboy. One day, Timmy's friend Billy came over to play. Billy was very enthusiastic about playing cowboys with Timmy. 

As they were playing, they saw a big, scary dog coming towards them. Timmy got scared and said, "Billy, that dog is a threat! We need to shoot it!" Billy replied, "Don't worry Timmy, I'll protect you." 

Billy took out his toy gun and pretended to shoot the dog. The dog ran away and Timmy was very happy that they were safe. "Wow, Billy! You're the best cowboy ever!" Timmy exclaimed. Billy smiled and said, "Thanks, Timmy. I'm always here to protect you." 

From that day on, Timmy and Billy played cowboys together every day. They were always ready to protect each other from any threats that came their way.

Once upon a time, there was a little crab named Sammy. Sammy loved to play with his friends on the beach. One day, Sammy found a big, shiny shell. He was so happy and wanted to show it to his friends.

Sammy went to his friends and said, "Look at my shell! It's so pretty!" But his friend, a bossy seagull named Gary, said, "That shell is not so great. It's too small."

Sammy felt embarrassed and sad. He went home and showed his mom the shell. She said, "Sammy, that shell is perfect for you. Don't let anyone make you feel bad about it."

Sammy felt better and went back to the beach to play with his friends. He showed them the shell again and this time they all said, "Wow, that's a great shell, Sammy!" Sammy felt happy and proud of his shell.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy who wanted to play in the sand. He went to the beach with his small bucket to collect some sand. He filled his bucket with the sand and played happily. 

Suddenly, he saw a big wave coming towards him. He tried to run away, but the wave was too strong. The wave took the little boy and his small bucket away. The little boy was scared and wanted to go back to his mommy, but he couldn't. 

The little boy and his small bucket were lost at sea. They floated for a long time until they got tired. The little boy was very sad and wanted to go back home, but he couldn't. Finally, a big storm came and the little boy and his small bucket were lost forever.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. One day, she went on a walk with her mommy and daddy. They walked and walked until they got to a big park. Lily was so excited to play on the swings and slide!

But after a while, Lily started to feel tired. She wanted to go home and take a nap. But her mommy and daddy wanted to take a photo of her on the slide first. So, Lily climbed up and slid down, but when she got to the bottom, she froze! She didn't want to smile for the photo.

Her mommy and daddy explained to her that it's important to smile and be happy, even when we're tired. Lily realized that they were right and she smiled for the photo. From then on, she always remembered to smile, even when she was tired. The end.

Once upon a time, there was a little birdie who lived in a big tree. One day, the birdie saw a flag stuck in a bush. The flag was waving in the wind and looked very pretty. The birdie thought it would be nice to have the flag in its nest.

But the bush was too prickly for the birdie to reach the flag. So, the birdie asked its friends, the squirrels, to help. The squirrels were happy to help and climbed up the tree. They rescued the flag and brought it back to the birdie's nest.

The birdie was very happy and felt peaceful with the pretty flag in its nest. From that day on, the birdie and the squirrels were good friends and helped each other whenever they needed it.

Lily went to her mom and asked for wisdom. Her mom told her to be gentle and careful when helping the bird. Lily listened and gently picked up the bird. 

Her little brother, Max, wanted to play with the bird too. He tried to grab it and play rough, but Lily told him not to disturb the bird. 

Lily took care of the bird until it was all healed up. She learned that being gentle and kind to animals is very important. It's not unusual to help others who need it.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to draw and color with her crayons. One day, she wanted to make a special picture for her mommy's birthday. She got out her crayons and started to draw a beautiful flower.

But then, her little brother came and accidentally rubbed his dirty hands on her picture. Lily was so sad and angry. She didn't know what to do. She thought and thought, and then she had an idea.

She decided to study how to make her picture even better. She used her creativity to add more colors and details to her flower. And when she was finished, it was even more beautiful than before! Her mommy loved it so much that she put it on the fridge for everyone to see. And Lily felt very proud of herself for being so creative and finding a way to solve her problem. The end.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She was very excited because her family was going on a holiday to the beach. She packed her bag with her favorite toys and clothes.

When they arrived at the beach, Lily saw a wise old man sitting under a big tree. He smiled at her and she smiled back. Suddenly, a strong wind came and tore her favorite dress. Lily started to cry.

The wise old man came over and gave her a big hug. He told her that it was okay and that they could fix the dress together. They sat under the tree and sewed the dress back together. Lily was so happy and grateful for the kind old man. From that day on, she knew that even when things tear, they can be fixed with a little bit of help.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play pretend with her toys. One day, she decided to go up to the attic to find some new things to play with. The attic was a small room at the top of the house where her family kept old things. 

As she climbed up the ladder, she saw a small box in the corner. Inside the box, she found a dress-up costume. Lily put on the costume and pretended to be a princess. She twirled around and danced in the attic, imagining she was at a fancy ball.

Once upon a time, there was a bunny named Bun. Bun loved to jump and play all day long. One day, Bun was jumping so high that he fell down and hurt his leg. His mommy put a bandage on his leg to make it feel better.

Bun was sad because he couldn't jump anymore. He sat on a rock and watched his friends jump without him. Suddenly, a charming butterfly landed on his nose. "What's wrong, Bun?" asked the butterfly. "I hurt my leg and can't jump anymore," replied Bun.

The butterfly had an idea. "Why don't we all play a game where we hop instead of jump?" suggested the butterfly. Bun's friends loved the idea and they all hopped together. Bun was so happy that he forgot about his hurt leg. From that day on, Bun and his friends played hopscotch instead of jumping. And they all lived happily ever after. The end.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She was very excited because her mommy had promised to take her to the park. She quickly put on her shoes and ran to the door.

"Wait for me, Lily!" said her little brother, Max.

Lily turned around and offered to hold Max's hand. "Come on, Max! Let's go to the park together!" she said.

They walked to the park and had so much fun playing on the swings and slides. When it was time to go home, Max was sad.

"Don't be sad, Max," said Lily. "We can come back to the park tomorrow!"

Max was happy again and smiled. "Thank you, Lily!" he said.

Lily hugged Max and they walked home together, happy and excited for their next adventure at the park.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. One day, she went for a walk on a path in the woods with her mommy. They saw a butterfly and Lily said, "I'm grateful for the pretty butterfly." 

Suddenly, they heard a noise and saw a big bear. Lily was scared and asked her mommy, "Can we run away?" Her mommy said, "No, we can't run. We need to be quiet and still." 

The bear came closer and closer. Lily's mommy whispered, "We need to weigh our options. We can try to scare the bear away or we can slowly back away." They decided to slowly back away and the bear didn't follow them. Lily was so happy they were safe and said, "I'm grateful we didn't get hurt by the bear."

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play with clay and make all sorts of things. One day, Lily made a big, round ball out of clay. She was so proud of it that she clapped her hands and jumped up and down.

But then, Lily's little brother came in and started playing with her clay. He mixed all the colors together and made a big mess. Lily was confused and didn't know what to do. She started to cry, but then her mom came in and helped her clean up the clay. 

Lily learned that it's okay to be confused sometimes, and that it's important to ask for help when you need it. And even though her clay creation was ruined, she still clapped her hands because she was happy to have her mom there to help her. The end.

Once upon a time, there was a furry little bunny named Bun Bun. Bun Bun loved to eat spaghetti for dinner every night. One day, when Bun Bun was eating his spaghetti, he heard a loud noise outside. He looked out the window and saw a big, scary wolf coming towards his house. 

Bun Bun was scared and didn't know what to do. He decided to study how to protect himself from the wolf. He read books and practiced his karate moves every day. One night, the wolf came back and tried to break into Bun Bun's house. But this time, Bun Bun was ready. He used his karate moves to fight off the wolf and protect his home. 

From that day on, Bun Bun knew that studying and practicing could help him overcome any challenge that came his way. And he continued to enjoy his spaghetti dinners every night, knowing that he was safe and protected.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She had a great yard where she loved to play. One day, Lily saw a shiny ball in her neighbor's yard. She asked her mom, "Can I have that ball? It's so pretty!" 

Her mom replied, "That ball belongs to your neighbor. You can't just take it. But you can ask if you can play with it." 

So, Lily went to her neighbor's yard and asked, "Can I play with your ball, please?" 

The neighbor smiled and said, "Of course! You can even borrow it if you want." Lily was so happy that she could play with the ball. She thanked her neighbor and ran back to her own yard to play. From that day on, Lily knew that it was important to ask before borrowing or taking someone else's things.
